description.zh: 用一排可切换的标签把同一区域的内容分成互斥视图：标签头常驻可点击，仅当前 标签对应的面板可见，其余隐藏。适合把高度相关的几类内容压缩在同一区域内 就地切换，避免整页跳转。键盘上用左右方向键在标签间移动，是可访问性的经典范例。
description.en: A row of switchable labels that divide one region into mutually exclusive views: the tab headers stay visible and clickable, and only the active tab's panel shows while the rest stay hidden. Packs several tightly related contents into one area to switch in place instead of full-page navigation. Arrow-key navigation between tabs makes it a classic accessibility showcase.

use_when.zh: 同一对象的几个平行视图（概览 / 动态 / 设置）
use_when.en: Parallel views of one object — overview / activity / settings

use_when.zh: 想就地切换、避免整页跳转
use_when.en: Switching in place instead of full-page navigation

use_when.zh: 内容高度相关且标签数 ≤ 7

avoid_when.zh: 各标签内容不相关，应拆成独立页面或路由
avoid_when.en: Unrelated contents — split into pages or routes

avoid_when.zh: 需要同时对照两个标签的内容
avoid_when.en: Users must compare two panes side by side

avoid_when.zh: 有先后顺序的多步流程（用分步指示器）

disambiguation.zh: Tabs 在同级内容面板间切换（内容同级并列）；Segmented Control 是紧凑的模式/筛选切换；Breadcrumb 显示层级位置。
disambiguation.en: Tabs switch peer content panels. A segmented control is a compact mode/filter switch. A breadcrumb shows hierarchical location.

note.zh: Segmented Control 更紧凑、用于模式/筛选，Tabs 用于内容分区。
note.en: A segmented control is compact for modes/filters; tabs section content.

note.zh: Breadcrumb 表达层级路径，Tabs 表达同级切换。
note.en: A breadcrumb shows hierarchy; tabs show peers.

note.zh: Sidebar 是常驻导航面，Tabs 是内容区内的切换条。
note.en: A sidebar is persistent navigation; tabs are a strip inside content.

note.zh: 激活项底部横线，Material 风格
note.en: Active marker under the label, Material-style

note.zh: 圆角分段控件，iOS Segmented 风格
标签即页签卡片，与面板连成一体
note.en: Tab cards fused with the panel

notes.zh: 语义结构 role="tablist" > role="tab"（aria-selected）+ role="tabpanel" （aria-labelledby，hidden 隐藏非当前面板）。激活指示器用绝对定位小横条， transform: translateX 滑动过渡；面板切换可加轻微 fade。键盘需实现左右 方向键移动焦点（roving tabindex）。
notes.en: Semantics: role="tablist" > role="tab" (aria-selected) + role="tabpanel" (aria-labelledby, non-active panels hidden). Animate the active indicator with an absolutely positioned bar sliding via transform: translateX; panels may fade on switch. Keyboard support needs roving tabindex with arrow keys.

basic.zh: 创建一个标签页组件：一排标签头加内容面板，点击或方向键切换，仅显示当前标签的面板。
basic.en: Create a tabs component: a row of tab headers plus panels, switched by click or arrow keys, showing only the active panel.

design.zh: 创建标签页：标签头等宽横排，激活项文字用主色并带 2px 底部强调色横线（横线 滑动过渡）；面板留白 16px；未激活标签为次级色。切换有轻微 fade。深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create tabs: equal-width headers in a row, active label in primary color with a 2px accent underline that slides between tabs; 16px panel padding; inactive labels in secondary color. Subtle fade on switch. Consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Tabs：role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel" 完整语义； activeId 受控；指示器用绝对定位 + translateX 过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1) 类变量便于调试）；面板切换 key 触发 fade 动画，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；roving tabindex 左右方向键。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind tabs: full role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel" semantics; controlled activeId; indicator as an absolutely positioned bar animated with translateX (duration multiplied by a speed variable for debugging); panels fade in via key changes, respecting prefers-reduced-motion; roving tabindex with arrow keys. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现标签页组件。

先检查现有组件体系是否已有 Tabs 或分段控件，优先扩展而非重写。
要求：
- 完整 ARIA 语义（tablist / tab / tabpanel / aria-selected）
- 左右方向键切换（roving tabindex）
- 激活指示器滑动动画，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 面板切换时保持各自的滚动或表单状态（keep-mounted 或缓存策略）
- 不新增不必要的依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Tabs component in the current project.

Check whether a tabs or segmented control already exists; extend rather than rewrite.
Requirements:
- Full ARIA semantics (tablist / tab / tabpanel / aria-selected)
- Arrow-key switching (roving tabindex)
- Sliding active indicator that respects prefers-reduced-motion
- Preserve per-panel scroll or form state (keep-mounted or caching strategy)
- No unnecessary dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 切换外观，再用 ← →、Home、End 切换内容面板。
task.en: Choose an appearance, then navigate panels with arrows, Home and End.

checks.zh: 焦点与选中标签同步，面板与标签有语义关联。
checks.en: Synchronize focus and selection; connect tabs to their panels.

checks.zh: 切换不会改变页面路由，相关内容留在同一上下文。
checks.en: Switch related content within the same context rather than navigating away.
